name: Long March 12
location_str: Commercial LC-2 @ Wenchang Space Launch Site, CHN
slot_a_text: 5 launches from Commercial LC-2 so far this year. 8 in total since it opened.
slot_b_text: The 44th launch of the year for China's CASC, 614th all time. 5th from Commercial LC-2 this year, 31 days since the last one. The 222nd orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
rocket_fact: Ion thrusters used on satellites produce about as much force as the weight of a single sheet of paper.
